lines.japanese: やった！　俺やったよ！
lines.english: I did it! I really did it!

lines.japanese: 小鳩！　俺おまえのために、がんばって集められるだけの署名を集めたよ！
lines.english: Kobato! I worked my butt off for you and collected every signature I could!

lines.japanese: きっとこの成果を知ったら、きゃあお兄ちゃん素敵ー抱いてーなどと言いながら歓喜するに違いない。
lines.english: When she learned what I had achieved, she would surely squeal, “Big Brother, you're wonderful! Take me!” and burst into rapture.

lines.japanese: いけないよ小鳩、俺たちは兄妹じゃないか……はは、駄目だって……うん、でも、そこまで言うなら仕方ないかな……うふふフフフふぁファヴぁばババ──
lines.english: We can't do that, Kobato. We're brother and sister... Ha-ha, no, we mustn't... Hmm, but if you insist, I suppose I have no choice... Ooh-hoo-hoo-hoo, fhah-fhavavavava—

lines.japanese: ──ウヴァアアアアアアァァァｌ！
lines.english: —UVAAAAAAAAAAAAGH!

lines.japanese: 待ってろよ、小鳩ぉ～！　きゃっほーう！
lines.english: Wait for me, Kobatooo! Yahoo!

lines.japanese: あふれる意気を抑えきれない俺は、前転→側転→倒立前転と繰りだしながら廊下を進み、フィニッシュには華麗なるムーンサルトで居間へと飛びこんだ（※誇張表現です）。
lines.english: Unable to contain my surging vigor, I proceeded down the hall with a forward roll, a cartwheel, and a handstand roll, then finished by moonsaulting gracefully into the living room. (*Some exaggeration may be present.)

lines.japanese: 「小鳩ォォォー！」
lines.english: “Kobatooooo!”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: はて、興奮しすぎてヘンな脳汁でも出てしまったんだろうか。何故って、素敵な幻覚が広がっているよ？
lines.english: Had I gotten so excited that my brain secreted some strange fluid? I had to wonder, because a beautiful hallucination stretched before my eyes.

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　えっ、ええっ……！」
lines.english: “What? Huh? Wh-what...?!”

lines.japanese: 「Ｇｅｔ　ｏｕｔ　ｈｅｒｅ」
lines.english: “Get out of here.”

lines.japanese: はっ！　もしかしてこれは、俺を奈落へいざなう魔性の罠か！？
lines.english: Wait! Could this be a demonic snare beckoning me into the abyss?!

lines.japanese: くそう、コンドルさんめ、相変わらず恐ろしい男だ。しかし、その手には乗らんぞ。
lines.english: Damn you, Condor. Terrifying as ever. But I won't fall for that trick.

lines.japanese: 俺たちはもう、そっちには戻らないんだ！
lines.english: We're never going back there!

lines.japanese: 俺はもう、何があったってここを動かないぞ！
lines.english: No matter what happens, I'm not budging from this spot!

lines.japanese: という決意も新たに、仁王立ちして天を睨んだ。
lines.english: My resolve renewed, I planted my feet wide and glared at the heavens.

lines.japanese: 「というわけだ小鳩、この署名の数を見てくれ！　こ、これならきっと、連載だって続くに違いない！」
lines.english: “So anyway, Kobato, look at all these signatures! Th-this should be enough to keep the series going!”

lines.japanese: 「い、いいから出てって」
lines.english: “I don't care. Get out.”

lines.japanese: 「出ていけだって！？」
lines.english: “You want me to leave?!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ。ああ、なんてことだろう。妹のためだと思って、この身を削って駆けまわったというのに、この子ったら感謝の気持ちは欠片もないときたもんだ」
lines.english: “Oh. Oh, what a cruel world! I ran myself ragged for my little sister, and the girl doesn't have one speck of gratitude in her.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、お兄さん、そういうことじゃなくて、私たち着替え中なんですけど……今日、みんなでお泊り会なので……」
lines.english: “U-um, mister, that isn't the issue. We're in the middle of changing... We're all having a sleepover tonight...”

lines.japanese: 「着替え中だと？　ふざけるな！　おまえらは着替え中かもしれないが、俺の小鳩に対する気持ちを少しは考えてくれたっていいじゃないか！　まったく、甘ったれるのもいい加減にするんだ！」
lines.english: “Changing? Don't be ridiculous! You girls might be changing clothes, but couldn't you spare one thought for how I feel about my Kobato?! Honestly, this selfishness has gone far enough!”

lines.japanese: 「Ｇｅｔ　ｏｕｔ　ｈｅｒｅ」
lines.english: “Get out of here.”

lines.japanese: 「待て待て、話を聞いてからでもいいじゃないか。見てくれ小鳩、俺、がんばって署名集めたんだよ。これなら連載だってまだまだ続くに違いないよ」
lines.english: “Wait, wait. At least hear me out. Look, Kobato. I worked really hard collecting all these signatures. The series is sure to keep running now.”

lines.japanese: 「れんさいって……何のこと……？」
lines.english: “What series...? What are you talking about...?”

lines.japanese: 「何のって、ほら、小鳩の好きな、あたしの涙がうんたらかんたら……」
lines.english: “What do you mean, what? You know, the one you love. *Let My Tears* Something Something...”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、あれ？　あの漫画、まだ終わらないらしいよ」
lines.english: “Oh, that? Apparently that manga isn't ending after all.”

lines.japanese: 「え、そうなの？」
lines.english: “Wait, really?”

lines.japanese: 「はい。作者さんがウェブでちょっぴりネガティブなつぶやきをしたら、それを見た読者さんたちが勝手に勘違いをしちゃったそうで」
lines.english: “Yes. The author posted one slightly negative comment online, and the readers who saw it all jumped to the wrong conclusion.”

lines.japanese: 「なあんだ、そうなんだあ！　ハハハ！」
lines.english: “Oh, that's all! Ha-ha-ha!”

lines.japanese: 「……って、俺のしたことぜんぶ無駄だったのか」
lines.english: “...Wait. So everything I did was pointless?”

lines.japanese: いいや！
lines.english: No!

lines.japanese: いまは喜ぶべき場面だ。小鳩の好きなものが残って、小鳩が幸せに笑っていられると言うのだから。
lines.english: This was a time for celebration. Something Kobato loved would survive, and Kobato could keep smiling happily.

lines.japanese: 「よかったなあ……よかったなあ小鳩……」
lines.english: “Thank goodness... Thank goodness, Kobato...”

lines.japanese: 俺は堪えきれず男泣きに泣いた。
lines.english: Unable to hold back, I wept manly tears.

lines.japanese: まるで心の穢れを洗いながすかのような、とても心地のよい涙だった。
lines.english: They were wonderfully soothing tears, as though washing every impurity from my heart.

lines.japanese: 「いえっ、ぼ、僕はいいんです。ううっ……ただ、ただ小鳩が喜んでくれるなら、本当にそれで……」
lines.english: “N-no! I don't matter. Sob... If Kobato is happy, then... then that's truly all I need...”

lines.japanese: 「Ｇｅｔ　ｏｕｔ　ｈｅｒｅ」
lines.english: “Get out of here.”

lines.japanese: 「なにっ！　ここを出ろだと、ふざけるなアリス、おまえは何様のつもりだ！」
lines.english: “What?! You want me to leave? Don't be absurd, Alice! Who do you think you are?!”

lines.japanese: 「私は着替え中だ。そしてあなたはただの変態だ」
lines.english: “I am changing my clothes. And you are only a pervert.”

lines.japanese: 「なにィ！？」
lines.english: “What did you say?!”

lines.japanese: そんな馬鹿な。いま俺は、妹のために泣いている感動巨編の主人公──
lines.english: Impossible. At this very moment, I was the protagonist of a moving epic, weeping for his little sister—

lines.japanese: あ、あれ？
lines.english: W-wait.

lines.japanese: 冷静になってよくよく周囲を見渡してみれば、どうやらアリスの言うことも一理ある状況だった。
lines.english: Once I calmed down and took a good look around, I had to admit there was something to Alice's assessment of the situation.

lines.japanese: あれれ？　ていうか、何この状況。今更だけど、何この桃色ロリっ娘パラダイス。
lines.english: Huh? Actually, what *was* this situation? It was a little late to ask, but what was this pink paradise of petite girls?

lines.japanese: 「あれっ、マジで……もしかして俺、ただの変態……？」
lines.english: “Wait, seriously... Am I just a pervert...?”

lines.japanese: や、やってもうた……これだから仮統合は……感情が昂ぶると、すぐ前しか見えなくなる……。
lines.english: I-I really screwed up... This was the problem with provisional integration. The second my emotions ran high, I lost sight of everything but what was right in front of me...

lines.japanese: 「Ｇｅｔ　ｏｕｔ　ｈｅｒｅ」
lines.english: “Get out of here.”

lines.japanese: だが落ちこむのは後だ。いまはとりあえずこの場を緊急離脱！
lines.english: I could wallow later. For now, I needed to make an emergency evacuation!

lines.japanese: 「ハハハ、それはすまなかった！　じゃあなみんな、また会おうっ！」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha! My apologies! Farewell, everyone. Until we meet again!”

lines.japanese: 力ずくならぬ爽やかずくで強引に締めて、俺は逃げた。
lines.english: I forced the scene to a close through sheer breeziness rather than brute force, then fled.

lines.japanese: ふすまを閉めてから数秒後、キャーとかヒィーとか悲鳴が聞こえた気もする。
lines.english: A few seconds after I closed the sliding door, I thought I heard screams of “Eek!” and “Aah!”

lines.japanese: しかし、全速力で部屋から飛びだして布団をかぶってしまったので定かではない。
lines.english: But I couldn't be sure, because I had sprinted out of the room at full speed and buried myself under the covers.

lines.japanese: 「ねえ森里君、例えば妹やその友達が着替えてる場へ入ってって、堂々としてるヤツがいたらどう思う？」
lines.english: “Hey, Morisato. Hypothetically, if a guy walked in while his sister and her friends were changing and then acted like he belonged there, what would you think?”

lines.japanese: 『いや、それ変態。つーか犯罪』
lines.english: “That's a pervert. Actually, that's a crime.”

lines.japanese: 「だよねー！」
lines.english: “Right?!”

lines.japanese: それから三日間、俺は小鳩に口をきいてもらえなかったとさ。めでたしめでたし。
lines.english: And for the next three days, Kobato refused to speak to me. And they all lived happily ever after.

lines.japanese: めでたくねぇー！
lines.english: Nothing happy about it!
